scripts.build: cd frontend && npm install && npm run build && node -e "const fs=require('fs'); const src='frontend/dist'; const dest='desktop/dist/IRIS-win32-x64/resources/app/dist-frontend'; if (fs.existsSync(src)) fs.cpSync(src, dest, {recursive: true, force: true});"
scripts.sync-desktop: node -e "const fs=require('fs'); const src='frontend/dist'; const dest='desktop/dist/IRIS-win32-x64/resources/app/dist-frontend'; if (fs.existsSync(src)) fs.cpSync(src, dest, {recursive: true, force: true});"
